title: Saudi point-of-sale spending, Q3 2022 vs Q3 2021

attempts.text: Saudi Arabia's point-of-sale card spending (SAMA) experienced a significant increase in the first quarter of 2022 compared to the same quarter of the previous year. The average weekly POS value for the quarter was SAR 10.85 bn, up 19.0% from SAR 9.11 bn in the same quarter of the previous year. This marked a 37.0% increase in the average weekly transactions, which were 144.4 million, up 37.0% from 105.4 million in the same quarter of the previous year. final_text: Average weekly point-of-sale spending in Saudi Arabia was SAR 10.85 bn in Q3 2022, up 19.0% from SAR 9.11 bn in Q3 2021. Average weekly transactions were 144.4 million (up 37.0%), and the average ticket was SAR 75.1 (down 13.1%). The largest movements were: Other increased by SAR 387 mn; Miscellaneous Goods and Services increased by SAR 329 mn; Restaurants & Café increased by SAR 292 mn.
